fichas.title: Youth Hostels: General Design Notes
fichas.summary: Youth hostels provide affordable accommodation and a range of group, educational, leisure and cultural services. The design guidance describes bedroom groups, shared facilities, dining and meeting spaces, utilities, staff accommodation, and flexibility for conversions. The page also illustrates traditional hostel bedding and a functional scheme.
uses: Affordable accommodation for young people, groups, school classes, singles and families
furniture_equipment: Folding bed used as a day couch

fichas.title: Hitzacker Youth Hostel
fichas.summary: A plan of the Hitzacker youth hostel identifies an entrance and reception area, dining and kitchen facilities, a seminar wing, and an accommodation wing. The accompanying legend lists circulation, service, staff and guest spaces. Architect: C. Schönwald.
